MNEMONIC_TOO_LONG: The mnemonic must be at most {max} characters.
MNEMONIC_MUST_START_WITH_LETTER: The mnemonic must start with a letter.
MNEMONIC_INVALID_CHARS: The mnemonic may only contain letters, digits and underscores.
MNEMONIC_BLOCK_FORMAT: A block variable's mnemonic must be written "BlockName.PortName".
TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_ZONE: The type "{type}" is not allowed here. Possible types: {allowed}.
ZONE_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE: The type "{type}" is not compatible with the "{zone}" zone.
ADDRESS_MISSING_PERCENT: The address must start with the % symbol.
